# Arbourview by Mattamy Homes — full site content

Independent builder and WideLot™ spotlight at https://arbourviewmattamy.com/. Last updated: 2026-09-01.

## Home — Arbourview by Mattamy Homes — WideLot™ Homes in Georgetown

Arbourview is a new pre-construction community by Mattamy Homes in Georgetown, part of Halton Hills, Ontario, planned to offer townhomes and detached homes built using Mattamy's WideLot™ design concept. Located at 10114 Eighth Line, the project is currently in its Coming Soon stage, with pricing and floor plans to be released to registered buyers first.

Builder: Mattamy Homes. Type: Townhomes & Detached Homes (WideLot™). Address: 10114 Eighth Line, Halton Hills, ON L7G 4S5. City: Georgetown, Halton Hills, Ontario. Nearby: Downtown Georgetown Main Street, Hungry Hollow trails. Connectivity: GO Transit, Highways 7, 401, 407. Starting Price: To be announced. Deposit: To be announced. Occupancy: To be announced. Status: Coming Soon — Registration Open.

Arbourview is Mattamy Homes' newest community in Georgetown, part of Halton Hills, Ontario, sited at 10114 Eighth Line on the edge of one of the GTA's most well-preserved small-town downtowns. Mattamy Homes is Canada's largest privately-owned homebuilder, founded in Toronto in 1978 by Peter Gilgan, and is known for WideLot™, introduced in the 1990s at The Orchard in Burlington.

## Floor Plans — Arbourview Floor Plans — Townhomes & Detached WideLot™ Homes

Arbourview floor plans have not been released by Mattamy Homes as of the project's Coming Soon stage. Planned collection tiers are townhomes and detached WideLot™ homes in Georgetown. Exact plan names, square footage, lot widths, and bedroom counts will be published at VIP launch.

## Pricing — Arbourview Prices & Deposit Structure

As of September 1, 2026, Mattamy Homes has not released pricing for Arbourview. Deposit structure and incentives are to be announced at VIP launch.

## Location — Arbourview Location — Eighth Line, Georgetown

Arbourview is located at 10114 Eighth Line, Halton Hills, Ontario, on the edge of Georgetown's established downtown. The community sits close to Georgetown's historic Main Street, the Georgetown Farmers' Market, and the Hungry Hollow trail and conservation area, with practical access to GO Transit and Highways 7, 401, and 407.

Schools: Halton District School Board and Halton Catholic District School Board catchment for Halton Hills is unconfirmed for this exact site.
